description: An ACK-ONLY whose RX LWE fails Test 4 starts a FULL RESET: the FULL RESET CMD is repeated with the same RESET FRAME ID when no acknowledgement comes, ARQ data waits meanwhile, and the FULL RESET ACK discards the partly sent C_PDU and lets the one not yet started go from FSN 0.
note: Link setup and first DATA-ONLY as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip (Caller): FSN 0 with 'ping' goes at 108000 and dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts at 118350. At 126000 the peer's ACK-ONLY carries RX LWE 7. Test 4 (C-0800): it must lie on the arc from TX LWE 0 to TX UWE + 1 = 1, and does not, so the D_PDU is not used (C-1170) and a FULL RESET starts (C-0791, C-0792): FULL RESET CMD, RESET FRAME ID 0, NEW RECEIVE LWE 0 (C-0805 to C-0809, C-1173). Regular data to the peer is suspended until the exchange completes (C-0257). The ACK-ONLY's EOT 10 gives an end at 131000, then contention 45000. At 140000 the client sends 'pong'; it is held behind the reset, and its later TTD leaves dts.ttd as it is. At 176000 the transmission carries the FULL RESET CMD only (C-0257). dts.ack_wait still runs and expires at 178350 while we transmit: FSN 0 is taken to have failed (C-1120), but nothing may be sent to the peer. At 181550 dts.reset_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with dts.ack_wait_ms, 60000 (C-1172). No acknowledgement comes: at its expiry the same FULL RESET CMD, same RESET FRAME ID 0 (C-0272: not reused until acknowledged), is queued again (C-0255, C-1172); our own transmission was the last, so LBT rule 3 (3000) then contention 36000, and it goes at 280550, bytes unchanged. At 291000 the peer's FULL RESET ACK ends the exchange (C-0264, C-0267, C-0821): dts.reset_wait stops; the windows go back to their initial values and the receive buffers are flushed (C-0822, C-0824, C-0825); 'ping', partly completed (its D_PDU has an FSN and is unacknowledged), is discarded and rejected to the CAS (C-0823, C-0826, C-1176; the SIS reports nothing until P6-1); 'pong', not yet started, stays queued (C-0826), so dts.ttd moves to its TTD (140000 + 1296000000). After the predicted end at 296000 and contention 33000, at 329000 'pong' goes as a DATA-ONLY with FSN 0 from the initial TX UWE (C-0189), TX WIN UWE and LWE set. dts.ack_wait starts at 339350; the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 at 346000 passes Test 4 and confirms it, so dts.ack_wait and dts.ttd stop. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Transmissions are zero filled: fill is P4-3's.
